240-574-1115-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
240-574-1115-5470.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

2645-3430-3756-5475.easyPrerequisites: Forensic Researcher doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-3756-5475.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

5107-5261-7290.easyPrerequisites:
Rally of Wings is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
5107-5261-7290.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
5107-5261-7290.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Does Machines.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Rally of Wings without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Rally of Wings, untapping all creatures you control and giving creatures you control that have flying +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2099-2595-4694-7306.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
2099-2595-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2099-2595-4694-7306.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-789-2033-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-789-2033-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Gutter Grime triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

6797-7435--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hardened Academic triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1669-3234-3293-4247.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1669-3234-3293-4247.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat
1669-3234-3293-4247.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1978-3099-5793-6700.description:
Activate Sarevok's Tome by tapping it, adding two mana.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sarevok's Tome which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.
1978-3099-5793-6700.notes: If you have completed a dungeon, you can activate Sarevok's Tome's last ability any number of times to cast all nonland cards in your library.

864-2104-7631.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness
When the Eternal Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2033-3459-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
2033-3459-5078-6650.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

3532-3536-5078-5402.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3536-5078-5402.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat from step 2

1661-4050-5078-7028.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

1369-3443-7086.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
1369-3443-7086.description:
Cast Touch of Vitae by paying {2}{G}, targeting Deathbloom Ritualist.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain Deathbloom Ritualist's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Deathbloom Ritualist's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Deathbloom Ritualist's ability granted to it by Touch of Vitae by paying {0}, untapping Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

1693-3750-7016.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Firebending Student.
1693-3750-7016.description:
Declare Firebending Student as an attacker, triggering its ability, adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to Leyline Tyrant.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
1693-3750-7016.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can kill Hellkite Tyrant and pay mana to deal infinite damage to any target.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

765-3609-6099-6881.description:
Play Guildless Commons. When it enters, it and Mossborn Hydra trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mossborn Hydra trigger, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Moxite Refinery by paying {2}, tapping it and removing three +1/+1 counters from Mossborn Hydra, putting three charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
765-3609-6099-6881.notes: You can remove as many +1/+1 counters from Mossborn Hydra to then place counters on Magistrate's Scepter. If you remove more than three, you may be able to forego steps 1-3 during some turns. You must ensure, however, that Mossborn Hydra will continue to have three or more +1/+1 counters on it afterwards.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is level 4 or higher

1318-2743-3130.description:
Cast Blue Sun's Twilight by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by tapping it, copying Blue Sun's Twilight twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Blue Sun's Twilight spells, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

454-509-1267-5546.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Jhoira's Timebug does not have summoning sickness.
454-509-1267-5546.description:
Cause Medomai to become an artifact.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Activate Jhoira's Timebug by tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 6.

2043-4321-4659-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copies of Magic Pot that is a 1/1 Soldiers and a Food token
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot and Food, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Magic Pot token dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure and a Food token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Food or Treasure, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

3490-4659-6283-6719.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4659-6283-6719.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Dazzling Angel indestructible.
3490-4659-6283-6719.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1323-3443-4687.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
1323-3443-4687.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Deathbloom Ritualist's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

360-678-5670.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using one colored mana with the mana to cast it.
360-678-5670.description:
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1268-3918-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least four.
1268-3918-4306.description:
Activate Trazyn using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.

3490-4050-4476-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4050-4476-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Answered Prayers indestructible.
3490-4050-4476-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-3147-4288.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3147-4288.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Sarinth Greatwurm, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

907-2976-4019-5227.notablePrerequisites:
Animate Land and Utopia Sprawl attached to Selesnya Sanctuary.
Selesnya Sanctuary does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Selesnya Sanctuary.
"Blue" chosen with Utopia Sprawl.
907-2976-4019-5227.description:
Cast Animate Land by paying {G}, causing Selesnya Sanctuary to become a creature until end of turn.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Utopia Srawl triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary.
Repeat.

1003-3156-3661-4763.notablePrerequisites: Demonmail Hauberk attached to Phyrexian Walker.
1003-3156-3661-4763.description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, targeting Shield Sphere.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Koll triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Shield Sphere.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Shield Sphere, targeting Phyrexian Walker.
When Shield Sphere dies, Koll triggers, returning Shield Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.

900-1550-2481-2493.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home and Sword of Feast and Famine attached to any other creature without summoning sickness.
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
An opponent is unable to block and kill the creature with the Swords attached.
900-1550-2481-2493.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home and Sword of Feast and Famine trigger.
Resolve the Sword of Hearth and Home trigger, blinking Archaeomancer and causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Seize the Day from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sword of Feast and Famine trigger, causing you to untap all lands you control, and causing the defending player to discard a card.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Cast Seize the Day by paying {3}{R}, causing you to untap the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home attached and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
 Repeat.
